描述_ZN: The Red Fugue" scroll, Ming Dynasty, painted by You Qiu, on paper with ink brush, 113 cm in length and 46 cm in width.　　According to the biography of Gnarled Beard of the Tang Dynasty, Yang Su, a powerful minister of the Sui Dynasty, was known by the surname of Zhang as Red Foo. One day, Li Jing, a minister of Wei, met Yang Su in his cloth and offered a strange strategy, and Red Foo, seeing his extraordinary ambition, admired him so much that he joined Li Jing at five o'clock that night and later assisted him in building his career. What is depicted in the painting is the scene of Li Jing meeting Yang Su. There are many characters in the painting, with different attitudes. The figures are depicted in white with smooth lines, and the women have beautiful physiques and are vividly evocative.　　This painting is signed: "Written in the summer of Yihai, Wanli. Changzhou Youqiu." Inscriptions: "Wu Ren You Qiu" in white and "Fengshan" in vermilion.
